adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes unauthenticated embed access checks to hit the DB: EmbedController#ensure_embeddable and TopicRetriever#invalid_host? now call EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer/@embed_url), which calls EmbeddableHost.record_for_host and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` each time. Previously this logic lived in SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? and operated on the in-memory `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` string. This is a concrete performance/architecture concern on a potentially high-traffic path, but not a correctness defect per se.
